screen.rationale: Primary study; HDPE microbeads from a facial scrub with C,N-TiO2 under a 50 W visible LED lamp (passes E3), but outcomes are only gravimetric MP concentration loss (71.77% without scavengers), FTIR carbonyl index, OM/SEM morphology and EDS oxygen; no molar mass and no identified product quantified.

excluded_observations.what: MPs' degradation (%) by gravimetry with/without scavengers
excluded_observations.why: Mass loss is not an E5 endpoint.
